metrics.metric: Agent Pay transaction volume or value
metrics.definition: Count or value of Agent Pay transactions.

metrics.definition: Banks named by Mastercard as completing controlled live agentic transactions on Priceless.com.

metrics.metric: Latin American issuers and processors with live transactions
metrics.definition: Named participants completing live agentic transactions.
Organizations named in the AP4M launch release.
metrics.caveat: Includes Mastercard Merchant Cloud; announced support, not live usage.

metrics.metric: Consumers projected to use agents routinely by 2030
metrics.definition: Mastercard projection of routine agent purchasing.
metrics.caveat: Projection; the release does not give its method.

costs.caveat: Secondary review by Nevermined, an AP4M participant.

costs.item: Agent-specific interchange, token fee, liability rule or reason code
costs.whoPays: Card economics unchanged (merchant pays usual card fees)
costs.caveat: Evidence of absence from two secondary sources; Mastercard has not stated that fees are unchanged.

costs.value: Tokens accepted through existing processors; PCI scope unchanged
costs.whoPays: Merchant pays its existing acquirer fees
costs.caveat: Mastercard describes no extra merchant fee; that is an absence of a statement, not a statement of zero fees.

costs.value: Sellers on Stripe support agentic network tokens automatically; no Agent Pay-specific Stripe price stated
costs.caveat: Normal Stripe card pricing presumably applies; not stated.
Settlement costs per rail not published.
